contradictions.reason: Accept the three .data deferrals: class bootstrap, default-class allocation, callback installation and fallback-LOD consumption are supported source behavior, but their compiled section membership and complete section characterization are not established.

Accept both .sbss deferrals because declarations do not prove section extent, order or placement. The mapping-query consumer is now directly confirmed: setup installs tobj_head and _HSD_TObjGetCurrentByType reads it. This resolves that source-level uncertainty, not the combined compiled-section claim; its unresolved disposition remains appropriate.
Accept all three .sdata deferrals. Diagnostic consumers are visible, but source literals cannot establish writable pool placement, padding, composition or ownership by the compiled target.

Accept all four .sdata2 deferrals. Color-byte conversion and matrix arithmetic retain their supported source meanings; emitted precision, pool composition, permissions and section membership require compiled evidence.

Accept the allocator side-effect deferral. The wrapper performs one construction call and no direct subsystem writes, but the replaceable default class prevents inferring unrestricted absence of indirect effects.

Accept the AOBJ_NO_UPDATE deferral. Ordinary interpretation receives NULL when this flag is set, whereas loop-boundary and completion stop calls still receive the texture callback. Blanket write suppression remains unverified without completing the FObj stop-path trace.

Accept the palette-sentinel qualification and unresolved disposition. Construction behavior is supported, but the explicit (u8)-1 initialization must not be flattened into an unqualified numeric -1; texture setup compares against the same cast sentinel.

Accept the ownership-context deferral. The inspected request helpers establish common-frame requests for generic texture chains, not model/interface ownership. No gameplay-specific interpretation is promoted.

Accept the TEV descriptor compatibility deferral. The nullable loader allocates a runtime record and copies sizeof(HSD_TObjTev) bytes; that operation alone does not independently verify target-compiler descriptor/runtime layout compatibility.
Accept supersession of the total-function claim by proposed fact 0. Unsupported coordinate inputs follow the assertion branch rather than an ordinary conversion case.

Accept supersession of the shared color/alpha selector characterization by proposed fact 1. The switches differ, and tev0/tev1 inputs are backed by stored configuration fields rather than live hardware-register reads.
